author: CC
prose: The verdict door (cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/verdict.py, _first_token_runs) refuses an instrument that opens with the shell's `!` negation, because `!` is not in _SHELL_HEADS and shutil.which cannot find it. Ticket 284798998ab0's validate berth wrote criterion 4 as `! grep ... | grep -v ...`, a legal command, and write_verdict refused it as 'no command could be run'. The refusal came only after the door had run the other three instruments, including an 85-minute full suite, so the whole reading was lost. Two things a fix would carry: `!` read as a shell head, and the extract check made for every entry BEFORE any instrument runs, so an unrunnable instrument refuses in seconds rather than after the slow ones.
